status.summary: Ranked #3 at middleweight and 5-0 (1 NC) since his Jan 2023 loss to Sean Strickland; last fought Sep 6, 2025 (unanimous decision over Caio Borralho, UFC Paris). Says the UFC promised him the next title shot after Strickland beat Khamzat Chimaev at UFC 328 (May 9, 2026); a Strickland rematch for the belt is reported for February 2027 in Florida but not officially announced.

status.next_fight: Reported, not official: vs Sean Strickland for the UFC middleweight title, targeted for February 2027 in Florida (MMA Junkie, Oct 27, 2026). An earlier September report had it on UFC 335 (Dec 12, 2026); that fell through over Strickland's pay dispute.

style.summary: A tall, jab-first orthodox striker who controls range with footwork and fast straight punches, then wins the late rounds of five-round fights. His counter-wrestling has become a strength: he stuffed 9 of 10 Brendan Allen takedowns in 2024. He rarely uses his own wrestling to hold top position.

moves.notes: Target groups follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 76.6% head, 14.7% body, 8.7% leg (career 77.5/14.7/7.8). The middleweight league split is about 77/14/9, so he is a near-typical head hunter who kicks the legs rarely. Inside the head group the jab leads, because Wikipedia and the Sherdog scouting report describe a footwork-and-jab game. The cross is second for the right hand that KO'd Adesanya. Hooks, uppercuts and head kicks stay small; no source highlights them. Body weights are split evenly because ufcstats does not separate punches from kicks. Leg kicks are rare but accurate (14/18 vs Borralho). Elbow 0.15 reflects the short elbow Sherdog calls his favourite close-range strike. Knee 0.1 reflects his 12% clinch share of sig landed. No spinning attacks are reported.
